reply.text: Sore after leg day is normal training soreness, and it usually eases as you keep showing up. Since you're asking what's on the menu, I'll check what I can see in the kitchen side of the app. Nothing came back for that search, so I can't pull a dish from your recipe book right now. If you tell me what you have on hand, I can suggest something simple from it, or I can look online for a recipe. For recovery, plenty of protein and enough food across the day will help, and it's a good idea to keep drinking water. Are you after something quick after training, or a bigger meal for tonight?
